entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Added Event Selector window, view model selection and UI wiring
entries.rationale: Provide a UI to browse and select race events using the Ergast API
entries.notes: EventSelectorWindow allows filtering and grouped display by year. OK/Cancel dialog returns the selected event. Visual Studio/MSBuild tooling may require a full IDE reload to pick up new XAML files; dotnet CLI build succeeded.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Redesigned MainWindow UI with clearer event display and button layout
entries.rationale: User reported Event button had a text entry box instead of a picker dialog. Restructured to show selected event display and trigger EventSelectorWindow via cleaner button layout.
entries.notes: MainWindow now has: event selection area with display text, Choose Event button that opens EventSelectorWindow dialog, Parameters/Predict buttons, and placeholder content area. Selected event updates the display text when dialog closes OK.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Enhanced EventSelectorWindow with status display, improved ListView template, and better error handling
entries.rationale: User reported ListView was empty with no events to pick. Added status text showing event count and error message if API fails. Improved ListView display template with race name and circuit. Added error handling to Ergast client with debug output.
entries.notes: EventSelectorWindow now displays event count or error message, has improved ListView template showing RaceName and CircuitName, and watches collection changes to update status. Ergast client catches both HttpRequestException and JsonException with debug output to assist diagnosing API issues.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Migrated from Ergast API to OpenF1 API for fetching race events
entries.rationale: User reported 404 errors from Ergast API endpoint. Switched to OpenF1 (https://openf1.org) which provides free historical F1 data (2023+) via a modern /meetings endpoint.
entries.notes: Replaced ErgastApiClient with OpenF1ApiClient. New client queries https://api.openf1.org/v1/meetings?year={year} and maps OpenF1 meeting fields (meeting_official_name, circuit_short_name, location, date_start) to EventRace properties. Removed old ErgastApiClient.cs file. EventSelectorViewModel now uses OpenF1ApiClient by default.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Filtered OpenF1 Sessions endpoint to race sessions only and limited year range to 2023+
entries.rationale: User noted API was loading pre-season testing sessions, not races. OpenF1 Sessions endpoint includes all session types. Also limited loading to 2023 onwards since that's the start of OpenF1 free historical data and avoids unnecessary API calls.
entries.notes: Changed query to sessions?year={year}&session_type=Race to filter for Grand Prix races only. Added HashSet tracking to deduplicate meetings (some meetings might have multiple race sessions). MainWindow now loads year range 2023 to current year instead of last 5 years.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Fixed API pagination and initial list display showing all events populated
entries.rationale: User reported only first result was being added and list was empty until filtering. Added limit=1000 parameter to OpenF1 query to fetch all races. Fixed EventSelectorWindow to display unfiltered list on load by clearing filter after events load.
entries.notes: Added &limit=1000 to API query to ensure all races are fetched (not just default limit). EventSelectorWindow now calls EventsView.Refresh() on filter text change. LoadAsync calls SetFilter(null) to ensure unfiltered view is displayed when dialog opens. Added debug output showing race count per year.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Switched to single API call to meetings endpoint to avoid rate limiting
entries.rationale: User reported hitting OpenF1 rate limits with per-year queries. Changed from querying /sessions once per year to querying /meetings?session_type=Race once for all races, then filter locally by year.
entries.notes: OpenF1ApiClient now queries meetings?session_type=Race endpoint in a single call (year parameter ignored for API, but kept for interface compatibility). EventSelectorViewModel.LoadAsync now calls API once, receives all races, filters locally by year range (startYear to endYear), and sorts by year descending then date ascending.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Fixed threading issue when updating ObservableCollection from async API call
entries.rationale: API call completes on background thread but ObservableCollection must be updated on UI thread. User reported NotSupportedException when adding to Events collection.
entries.notes: Added using System.Windows and Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke() to marshal collection updates back to UI thread before adding items to Events. Also added try-catch with debug output for LoadAsync errors. Wrapped filteredRaces in .ToList() before dispatcher call to avoid threading issues in LINQ enumeration.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Added Raw Data window with lap matrix view, driver-name mapping, and hover details
entries.rationale: User requested a new window opened from main view, disabled until a meeting is selected, showing a large driver-by-lap table with lap durations and full-lap tooltip details.
entries.notes: Raw Data button is disabled by default and enabled once race laps/drivers load for a selected meeting. Table columns are lap numbers, row header is driver full name, lap durations are formatted to 3 d.p., and each cell tooltip shows serialized lap details.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Added reference lap time calculation using race control SC/VSC windows
entries.rationale: User requested filtering out pit-out laps and laps starting/ending during Safety Car/Virtual Safety Car periods before summing lap durations into a reference time.
entries.notes: Race control windows built from SafetyCar/Safety Car category messages using VSC DEPLOYED->VSC ENDING and SAFETY CAR DEPLOYED->SAFETY CAR IN THIS LAP. Laps with start or end inside a window are excluded.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Added fuel-effect adjusted reference lap calculation with observable fuel parameters
entries.rationale: User requested fuel effect based on seconds per 10kg and fuel kg, using session max lap number and subtracting per-lap fuel effect from reference lap sum.
entries.notes: Added observable properties FuelSecondsPer10Kg=0.3 and FuelKg=110 with TODO to move into Parameters menu. Fuel correction uses fuelEffectPerLap * (maxSessionLapNumber - lapNumber) on clean non-pit-out, non-SC/VSC laps.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Enhanced Raw Data view with extra info, mode switching, reference row, pit/stint styling
entries.rationale: User requested extra info bar, pit lap highlighting, reference lap row, individual/cumulative switcher, and stint-based compound borders matched to drivers.
entries.notes: Added stints API retrieval and mapped compounds by driver/lap range. Raw data cells now show orange pit-lap fill, red/yellow/white compound borders with black grid lines, reference bottom row, and cumulative display mode.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Implemented ScottPlot race trace in main view with cumulative reference deltas
entries.rationale: User requested race trace as main view using ScottPlot with Y=0 as reference lap baseline, all drivers, X=lap number, per-driver colors, and solid vs dashed style by driver number.
entries.notes: ScottPlot.WPF added. Plot hosted in code-behind to avoid designer SkiaSharp load issues. Lowest driver number rendered solid; others dashed. Y-axis shows cumulative (lapDuration-referenceLap) with baseline horizontal line at zero.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Redesigned race trace to Engineering Mode with dynamic lap-by-lap field reference
entries.rationale: User identified fixed-baseline traces were not representative and requested moving field-average style behavior like race engineering traces.
entries.notes: Added top-bar controls for including pit laps, including SC/VSC laps, and fuel correction. Trace now uses cumulative delta vs moving per-lap field median with consistent filtering and adjustment logic. Added TODO note for future Reference Pace mode.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Added broadcast name to race trace legend labels
entries.rationale: User requested broadcast name be included in chart legend for clearer driver identification.
entries.notes: Mapped OpenF1 driver field broadcast_name and updated legend formatting to CODE (BroadcastName) when available.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Adjusted race trace line style to teammate-based lower/higher driver number rule
entries.rationale: User requested lower driver number be solid and higher driver number dashed while preserving team colours.
entries.notes: Line style now determined per team group (team name fallback to team colour): lower-numbered teammate solid, higher-numbered teammate dashed.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Increased race-trace marker size and matched marker color to line color
entries.rationale: User requested larger lap point dots and same color as each driver line.
entries.notes: Set scatter marker size to 8 and marker fill/outline colors to the same value as line color.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Disabled race trace interactivity when no event is loaded
entries.rationale: User requested graph scrolling/interaction be deactivated until event data is loaded.
entries.notes: Added SetRaceTraceEnabled helper; graph input disabled by default, during loading, and on no-session/error states; re-enabled after successful data load. Also dims plot opacity while disabled.

entries.summary: Added legend sort option for race trace
entries.rationale: User requested ability to sort legend by driver number or by team then driver number.
entries.notes: Added LegendSortComboBox with two modes and wired SelectionChanged to re-render. Plot series addition order now follows selected legend sort strategy.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Added clickable legend names to show/hide driver traces
entries.rationale: User requested clicking legend names to toggle trace visibility.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Updated legend toggle behavior and event selector double-click
entries.rationale: User requested dimming traces instead of hiding, right-click isolate in legend, and double-click event selection.
entries.notes: Legend toggles now keep all traces plotted; deselected traces are visually reduced to ~15% by blending toward white. Right-click on a legend item isolates that driver. EventSelectorWindow now accepts double-click on selected row to confirm.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Switched race trace from moving reference to constant reference baseline
entries.rationale: User identified implementation drift and requested cumulative delta be computed against fixed reference lap value from reference calculation.
entries.notes: Removed per-lap referenceByLapNumber usage. Trace now uses constantReference = _currentReference.AverageLapTimeSeconds and lapDelta = constantReference - adjustedLapSeconds. Updated chart labels/baseline text accordingly.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Updated copilot-instructions.md to align with dissertation and user decisions
entries.rationale: User confirmed: drop Stay Out/?G for now; primary point n+1; single warm-up penalty; degradation per-compound; fuel excluded from prediction engine; three-way marginal classification
entries.notes: GapAtN1/N2/N3 naming; UndercutClassification Ahead/Marginal/Behind; OutLapPenaltySeconds; DegradationRatesSecondsPerLap on LapModelParameters; ReferencePaceSeconds driver-specific auto-derived; ?G deferred as future work

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Built deterministic undercut prediction engine (domain types + services)
entries.rationale: User requested prediction engine implementation following dissertation analysis and instruction update
entries.notes: L=B+C+D+W+R+P model. Per-compound degradation. Single out-lap warm-up penalty. Three gaps (n+1 primary, n+2, n+3). Three-way classification (Ahead/Marginal/Behind, +/-0.25s). Negative gap = attacker ahead. Tyre state transitions correct: old tyre on pit lap, replacement starts on out lap.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Added DeltaG fields to PredictionResult; corrected DeltaG definition following dissertation section 3.6 rewrite
entries.rationale: New dissertation section 3.6 defines DeltaG(n)=G(n)-G0 (gap change during pit sequence) not DeltaG=Gund-Gref (vs Stay Out). No Stay Out scenario required. Trivially derived from existing engine outputs.
entries.notes: PredictionResult now has InitialGapSeconds + DeltaGAtN1/N2/N3Seconds. DeltaG = G(n) - G0 = T_A(n) - T_T(n). Negative = attacker gained time. Stale 'deferred' note removed from code XML doc. No instructions changes needed.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Aligned single-scan gap calculation with full-scan logic using absolute Sector 2 crossing timestamps

entries.buildResult: Build succeeded with existing warning CS8629 in ScanWorkflow.Candidates.cs
entries.notes: GetGapBetweenDriversAtLap now delegates to WorkspaceWorkflowService.TryDeriveInitialGapSeconds to match full-scan g0 convention.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot

entries.buildResult: Build succeeded during dotnet test run
entries.notes: Tests validate absolute Sector 2 crossing-time gap convention, sign convention, candidate filtering with non-positive gaps, and parity between full-scan candidate g0 and single-scan derived gap for same lap/drivers.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Added explicit regression test to ensure ahead-ordering uses Sector 2 crossing, not lap duration
entries.rationale: User requested additional hardening after audit concern that scans might use final lap times instead of decision-point timing
entries.notes: New test BuildOnTrackOrderPerLap_UsesSectorTwoCrossing_NotLapDuration intentionally sets opposite lap-duration ordering to verify S2 crossing governs ahead/behind order.
